$comment: Decisions for scripts/sync-npc-spawns.ts (docs/npc-spawns.md): Wiki spawns it labels in its report, and leaves out of npc-spawns.json when `skip` is true. `categories` are cache NPC categories (opcode 18), `names` cache NPC names, `pagePatterns` regular expressions on the Wiki page title, `boxes` areas ("minX,minY,maxX,maxY[,plane]") such as instance templates a plugin spawns itself.

2353.label: Sailing sea creature
2353.why: Sea encounters for Sailing (sharks, rays, krakens, seabirds) in open water; reachable only by boat.

unalignedLayers.label: Wiki map layer not aligned
unalignedLayers.why: The Wiki draws some dungeons on their own map layers with other coordinates; when too few of a layer's spawns line up with existing ones to work out the shift, its spawns could land in the wrong place.

Gate of War.label: Handled as an object
Gate of War.why: Stronghold of Security door: tsps opens it as a scenery object (StrongholdOfSecurity.plugin.js).

Ricketty door.label: Handled as an object
Ricketty door.why: Stronghold of Security door: tsps opens it as a scenery object.

Oozing barrier.label: Handled as an object
Oozing barrier.why: Stronghold of Security door: tsps opens it as a scenery object.

Portal of Death.label: Handled as an object
Portal of Death.why: Stronghold of Security door: tsps opens it as a scenery object.

Gemstone Crab.label: Spawned by a plugin
Gemstone Crab.why: GemstoneCrab.plugin.js spawns the timed world boss at one of its three spots itself.

Sol Heredit.label: Spawned by a plugin
Sol Heredit.why: The Fortis Colosseum's final boss, spawned by the run in its arena (ColosseumRun.js).
